summary: Frontend-only UI check of the Dressing Room expansion at http://localhost:3000/dressing-room/evil_victoria (vite preview bundle), 1920x1080. Everything requested passed: the page loads with no React errors or warnings (the only console errors are the expected CORS/Failed-to-fetch calls to the Railway backend). The KEEP UNTOUCHED section shows 6 toggles with the right data-testids. Face, hair and skin tone start ON (lock emoji, green glow); body, pose and background start OFF. Each toggle switches state and switches back. All 8 category headings show the expected counts: TOPS 134, BOTTOMS 118, SHOES 116, POSITIONS 80, BACKGROUNDS 70, DRESSES 60, DRAGONBALL 82, VILLAINESSPOSES 30. All 7 spot-check items appear exactly once in the right category, and their background changes when clicked. A node script found no duplicate item names in any category, so no React key collisions. Backend /generate was not called, as instructed.

integration_issues.issue: The KEEP UNTOUCHED panel shows in every generation mode, but the preserve_* flags are only sent in the Outfit-mode /generate request body. TryOn, Headshot and Foot-to-Head ignore them, so a user can turn on toggles that do nothing.

issues: In the generic renderer, a selected pill is hard to see: the gradient alpha is only 25/15 hex (~0.145/0.08) and the dim grey text sits on a dark red tint. Dedicated sections like Backgrounds use 35/20 alpha plus a glow.
The heading 'VILLAINESSPOSES (30)' is the raw camelCase key uppercased. Consider a label map, e.g. 'VILLAINESS POSES'.
Pill text in the wardrobe lists is low contrast (grey on near-black).

action_items: Optional: hide or disable the KEEP UNTOUCHED panel outside Outfit mode, or send the preserve flags to the tryon/headshot/foot-to-head endpoints too
Optional: make the selected state in the generic category renderer stronger (higher alpha plus a boxShadow glow, like the Backgrounds section)
Optional: add a display label for villainessPoses ('Villainess Poses')
Optional: add data-testid to pills in the generic category renderer, e.g. data-testid={`item-${category}-${slug}`}
critical_code_review_comments: DressingRoom.jsx is about 2250 lines. Move CLOTHING_CATEGORIES into its own data module (e.g. src/data/wardrobe.js) and split the panels into components.
The pill render blocks are copied almost unchanged across about 8 sections. Extract a <PillGroup> component.

generateOutfitPrompt drops some selections without telling the user. If presetCostumes is set, a dragonball or dress selection is ignored. If a dress is set, tops and bottoms are ignored. Mutually exclusive selection or a UI hint would help.
Backend preserve_* fields are Optional[bool] with True defaults. An explicit null from a client would be treated as False. Consider plain bool.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is a vite preview bundle on localhost:3000 and points at the Railway backend, so CORS errors are expected locally. Pills in the generic renderer have no data-testid. Select them with get_by_role('button', name=<item>, exact=True). Selected state is checked via the computed backgroundImage gradient.
